english.note: Use this for the generic social-gathering sense of a dance, rather than a disco-branded event.
Use 舞會 for an organized formal dance, not simply any enjoyable occasion.

examples.english: Our school has a disco next week. Are you going?
examples.traditional: 學校下星期有個舞會，你去唔去？
